Epic Fight Recommended!!

Credits:

Modelers: Ash, Net, Corey

Architect: Nimlim

Animator: Yousef

Pixel Artist: Net, Faded Knight

Progression


- Find Meteor Structure
- Acquire Mul Stone And Raw Mul (Mul Ore)
>-- Mul Stone - Polished Mul - Mul Bricks
  >-- Mul Brick Stairs, Mul Brick Slab, Mul Brick Wall, Mul Brick Button
- Smelt Raw Mul To Acquire Refined Mul
- Combine Refined Mul With Cursed Amethyst Bottles To Craft Mul Scraps
- Craft Mul Scraps and Iron Ingots Into Mul Ingots
- Craft A Weapon Forge
- Craft Tenzo
- Acquire Special Grade Technique Essence From LimitLess/Shrine/StarRage/Disaster Flames Ruins
>-- Trade With The Simurian Trader In the Simurian House
- Craft ---
                Hollow Blade <> LimitLess Essence
                Shrine Blade <> Shrine Essence
                Stellar Blade <> Star Rage Essence
                Fiery Blade <> Disaster Flames Essence

Blocks

  • Mul Ore
  • Mul Stone
  • Polished Mul
  • Mul Bricks
  • Mul Brick Stairs
  • Mul Brick Slab
  • Mul Brick Wall
  • Mul Brick Button
  • Weapon Forge
  • Items
  • Raw Mul
  • Refined Mul
  • Mul Scrap
  • Mul Ingot
  • Special Grade Cursed Technique Essence (X4)

- Weapons


  •

    Hollow Blade


  • Shrine Blade


  • Stellar Blade


  • Fiery Blade


  • Tenzo

    - Abilities 

    Hollow Blade - Holds The Enemy In Place With Blue And Blasts Them Off With Red

     

    Shrine Blade - Attacks The Enemy With Relentless Slashes

     

    Stellar Blade - Blasts The Enemy With Gravity Explosions

     

    Fiery Blade - Traps And Sets The Enemy On Fire With Magma While Also Simultaneously Exploding Them

    Tenzo - Base For All Weapons

    1. Upgrades

      After A Blade Is Crafted, It Can Be Further Upgraded To Have An Ultimate Ability.
       Weapon --> Refined Mul --> Special Grade Essence = Upgraded Weapon.
      Once A Weapon Is Upgraded A New GUI Overlay Will Be Visible Consisting Of 5 Charges. Everytime The 6 Value Requirements Are Met And The Ability Is Used The Charge Goes Up By 1. Once It Fills Up An Ultimate Ability Is Used And The Charges Are Reset.
      Hollow Blade <> Hollow Nuke
      Shrine Blade <> Divine Flames
      Stellar Blade <> Black Hole
      Fiery Blade <> Maximum Meteor <time datetime="2026-07-26T16:55:52.449Z"></time>
       
       

    - Epic Fight Compatible
